purpose.description: Your CSS and HTML implement the typography-focused tasks for the Morocco project and the page renders with the specified fonts and weights.
Overall structure mirrors the task list (header weight, banner heading weights, line-height adjustments, and fonts from Google Fonts).

readability.description: Good separation of sections with clear class names like header, banner, journal, and footer which makes styling straightforward.
Fonts are imported from Google Fonts and font-family usage is evident in banner and journal sections.

performance.description: Using a single @font-face for Croissant One aids performance by loading a local font once.
Avoid repeated font-family fallbacks by declaring a consistent font stack in a root selector if needed for performance.
